snippet.title: One Move Away - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
One Move Away is a 3D, first-person puzzle game that blends puzzles with packing vehicles. Players experience packing at various stages of life, each level offering their own challenges. Master the art of packing by completing every objective!

We're thrilled to announce the title will be out May 28th 🥳


Platform stores:
Steam:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3172440/One_Move_Away
PlayStation:  https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10013306
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-gb/games/store/one-move-away/9nzl6x6pt7bt
Switch https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/one-move-away-switch/
